checkRuns.command:
pkill -f "next start"; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='app/layout.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''          <Suspense fallback={<MainNav />}>
            <CurrentMainNav />
          </Suspense>''','''          <CurrentMainNav />''')
s=s.replace('import { Suspense } from "react";\n','').replace('{ CurrentMainNav, MainNav }','{ CurrentMainNav }')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
bun run build 2>&1 | tail -30
grep -n "Suspense\|MainNav" app/layout.tsx; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -30

python3 - <<'EOF'

EOF

bun run check 2>&1 | tail -2; for s in moby-dick the-time-machine pride-and-prejudice; do curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/books/$s | grep -o '<article>.*</article>' | head -c 400; echo; done; bash /tmp/stop.sh; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:4701/ ; pgrep -fa "next" ; git status --short
